# Author: QAQ Automaton

import sys
import math
from collections import defaultdict

# Fast I/O functions
def read_int():
    return int(sys.stdin.read())

def read_list():
    return sys.stdin.read().split()

# Constants
p = 1000000007

# Fast exponentiation
def fpm(a, b):
    c = 1
    while b:
        if b & 1:
            c = c * a % p
        a = a * a % p
        b >>= 1
    return c

# Initialize variables
n = read_int()

a = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
f = [[0]*(1 << n) for _ in range(n)]
is_mask = [0]*(1 << n)

# Read matrix and process
data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
idx = 0
mx = 0
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        a[i][j] = data[idx]
        idx += 1

# Compute modular inverse of 100
i100 = fpm(100, p - 2)

# Scale matrix elements
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        a[i][j] = a[i][j] * i100 % p

# Precompute is_mask
for i in range(n):
    is_mask[1 << i] = i

# Compute f
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(1 << n):
        val = 1
        for k in range(n):
            if j & (1 << k):
                val = val * a[k][i] % p
            else:
                val = val * (p + 1 - a[k][i]) % p
        f[i][j] = val

# Define the LLL class
class LLL:
    def __init__(self):
        self.a = 0
        self.b = 0

    def set(self, x):
        if x < 64:
            self.a |= 1 << x
        else:
            self.b |= 1 << (x - 64)

    def reset(self):
        self.a = 0
        self.b = 0

    def __ior__(self, other):
        self.a |= other.a
        self.b |= other.b
        return self

    def __eq__(self, other):
        return self.a == other.a and self.b == other.b

    def __getitem__(self, index):
        if index < 64:
            return (self.a & (1 << index)) != 0
        else:
            return (self.b & (1 << (index - 64))) != 0

# Initialize the maximum LLL
mx = LLL()
for i in range(1 << n):
    mx.set(i)

# Initialize memoization dictionary
st = [defaultdict(int) for _ in range(n)]
st[0][LLL()] = 1

# Recursive DFS with memoization
def dfs(x, w):
    if x == n:
        return 1 if w == mx else 0
    if w in st[x]:
        return st[x][w]
    ans = 0
    s = [LLL() for _ in range(n)]
    for j in range(n):
        s[j].reset()
    for i_mask in range(1 << n):
        if (w.a & (1 << i_mask)) or (w.b & (1 << i_mask - 64) if i_mask >= 64 else 0):
            for j in range(n):
                if not (i_mask & (1 << j)):
                    s[j].set(i_mask | (1 << j))
    for i_mask in range(1 << n):
        if (w.a & (1 << i_mask)) or (w.b & (1 << i_mask - 64) if i_mask >= 64 else 0):
            ng = LLL()
            ng.a = w.a
            ng.b = w.b
            for j in range(n):
                if (i_mask & (1 << j)):
                    ng |= s[j]
            ans = (ans + f[x][i_mask] * dfs(x + 1, ng)) % p
    st[x][w] = ans
    return ans

# Compute and output the result
result = dfs(0, LLL())
print(result)
